purpose: Independently reproduce the M9Z historical M5/H1/H4 payoff references from the frozen M9S branch populations using only the same immutable hashed GOLD CSVs, before any separate fresh prospective design.

M5_ENTRY.definition: Frozen M9S S1; at first causal M1 turn use latest fully closed M5 Wilder ATR14; reclaim level = original PRIMARY bid/open - 0.15*ATR; immediate entry if first-turn M1 open is already >= level, otherwise wait at most 6 fully closed M1 bars and enter exact next M1 open ask after first close >= level; skip if no reclaim before timeout/native exit.

M5_RUNNER75.definition: From M5_ENTRY; at native M5 exit, latest fully closed M15 MACD(6,13) raw line strictly rising versus previous fully closed M15 enables 75% runner; runner exits at first causal M5 RCI9 turn-down decision at/after native exit; one-position accounting, later entries while active are skipped/metadata.

H1_ENTRY.definition: Frozen M9S S3; at first causal M1 turn use latest fully closed H1 Wilder ATR14; reclaim level = original PRIMARY bid/open - 0.05*ATR; fully closed M5 confirmation; maximum 30 minutes; after first M5 close >= level enter exact M1 open at that confirmation close-time, or first-turn ask when the latest fully closed M5 already confirms; native H1 exit unchanged.

H1_RUNNER50.definition: From H1_ENTRY; at native H1 exit, latest fully closed H4 MACD and latest fully closed D1 MACD raw lines must both be strictly rising versus their previous fully closed bars; then retain 50% runner; runner exits at first causal H1 RCI9 turn-down decision at/after native exit; one-position accounting.

H4_ENTRY.definition: Frozen M9S S4; original PRIMARY bid/open itself is the reclaim level; require fully closed M15 reclaim within maximum 60 minutes; enter exact M1 open at confirmation close-time, or first-turn ask when latest fully closed M15 already confirms; native H4 exit only; no runner is promoted from M9Z history.

promotion.next_after_user_local_pass: Freeze a separate NEW fresh prospective payoff-extension contract with an independent future start. Do not retrofit M9V/M9Y and do not reuse M9V/M9Y starts.
